projects.title: Data Science & Transnational Security Collider - UC Berkeley
projects.description:
Frontend developer for project creating more user friendly and feature rich Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctions database. Interviewed numerous analysts who use current OFAC database to build Web Application customized to the analysts needs. Pitched idea and demo to members of US Treasury, think tanks, and former leaders in intelligence community in Washington DC. The OFACasaurus was built using a backend of Flask and MongoDB and with HTML, CSS, and Javascript for the frontend.
After being personally affected by the terrorist attack in Nice joined The Data Science & Transnational Security Collider: a UC Berkeley class created by students that is focused on bringing Silicon Valley tech solutions to DC’s most pressing problems.
